SELECT 
  cls, 
  boat, 
  fished_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat,
  ROUND(AVG(anglers), 1) as avg_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5', 'overnight')
  AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 200 AND 275
GROUP BY cls, boat, fished_date_doy
ORDER BY avg_yt_per_boat DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  cls,
  fished_date_doy,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(*) as boat_count,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_boat,
  MIN(yt) as min_yt,
  MAX(yt) as max_yt
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5', 'overnight')
  AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 200 AND 275
GROUP BY cls, fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats_available,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cls) as classes_available
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 30

SELECT 
  boat,
  cls,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as avg_yt,
  ROUND(STDDEV(yt), 1) as std_yt
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5', 'overnight')
  AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 200 AND 275
GROUP BY boat, cls
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY avg_yt DESC
LIMIT 20
